newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 16.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY

- China's official body for guiding ethical and cultural progress urges whole country to pay closer attention to more civil language and deeds, a clean environment, good services, and orderly traffic.
- Premier Li Peng, in visit to Lucky Film Corporation, says film business should develop more, and the company should make a greater contribution by adapting itself to the market.

- Politburo Standing Committee member Li Ruihuan meets Do Muoi, general secretary of Vietnamese Communist Party and says China and Vietnam are close neighbours and the two peoples maintain deep traditional friendship.
- Forum in Beijing marks 50th anniversary of founding of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China's first autonomous region.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Front page article says Chinese Communist Party has scored great achievements in improving the theory of Party building since 14th congress in 1992

- In meeting with visiting Vietnamese Communist Party leader Do Muoi in Beijing, Qiao Shi stresses the sincerity and friendly cooperation between China and Vietnam will benefit development of both countries.
CHINA DAILY
- Chinese Vice-Premier and Foreign Minister Qian Qichen expresses hope that China and Vietnam will soon settle their border issues.
- China is ready to make concerted efforts with Vietnam to develop comprehensive and in-depth relations, Premier Li Peng tells visiting Vietnamese Communist Party leader Do Muoi.

- Vice-Premier Li Lanqing says China has made many achievements in anti-smuggling campaign, especially in coastal areas. From January to June, a total of 20,908 smuggling cases were uncovered, involving more than 15 billion yuan ($1.8 billion)
FINANCIAL NEWS
- China issues detailed rules on settlement of letters of credit used in domestic trading
- Central bank survey in Beijing finds bank savings rate falls as people invest more in stocks, stamps
- Editorial says stock investors should be responsible for their gains and losses instead of complaining to the authorities
CHINA SECURITIES
- Central bank survey shows 70.1 percent of depositors see stable prices, while 34.5 percent choose time deposits, down by one percentage point
- Survey by Industrial Economics Research Institute says supply of most industrial products exceeds demands, forecasts uprsurge in company mergers in next three to five years
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- U.S. tobacco giant Philip Morris co-sponsors Chinese bridge tournament
MARKET DAILY
- Yunnan, Guizhou face shortfalls in kerosene, gasoline
- Smuggling of diesel oil depresses prices in Jiangsu province
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Profits of some key People's Liberation Army firms show rise of 9.2 percent in 1996
